notes: Corrected s001/s003: the supplied 'part' moves from the adjective to the article under rule 102, which scopes rule 17's generic-noun clause to anarthrous Greek, and the unit heads on the supplied nominal.
MAT.21.15's τὰ θαυμάσια → 'the … things' / 'wonderful' is the same construction in this chapter and is now analysed alike, as rule 24 requires.
ὄχλος keeps 'of the multitude' headed on the noun; the supplied 'of' belongs to the ASV's partitive recast rather than to a Greek case, so it does not ride with the article.
